question: The river Indus lies to the _______ of the Great Indian Desert.
solution:
The correct answer is **__West. __**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indus River is a** Trans-Himalayan, Antecedent River** that originates in Western Tibet from **Lake Mansarovar(Kailash Mountain Range)** and drains into the **Arabian Sea near Karachi(Pakistan).**
 
• In India, **this river flows northwest through the Ladakh and Gilgit-Baltistan regions of Kashmir **after which, it **bends sharply to the left after the Nanga Parbat**, and then at** last flows south and enters Pakistan.**
 
• **Total Length of the River**- approximately 3180km.
 
• **Total Drainage Area of the River**- approximately 11,65,000 sq. km.
 
• **Left Bank Tributaries of the Indus Rivers**- Zanskar river (Ladakh), Panjnad Rivers (word used for the rivers Jhelum, Chenab, Beas, Sutlej, and Ravi)
 
• **Right Bank Tributaries of the Indus River**- Shyok River, Gilgit River, Kabul River, Kurram River, and Gomal River.
 
• **Indus** also finds its name in the **Rigveda as the "Sindhu" river.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 **__Indus Water Treaty:__**

 
• It is an agreement, which was signed between **India and Pakistan, brokered by the World Bank in the year 1960.**
 
• Under this treaty, the **waters of the three Eastern rivers (the Ravi, the Beas, and the Satluj) shall be for the exclusive use of India** while the **waters of three Western rivers (the Indus, the Jhelum, and the Chenab) shall be for the exclusive use of Pakistan.**
 
• **India** has approximately** 20% of the total water** carried by the Indus system while** Pakistan possesses the remaining 80%**.
